Mizan Digital Services designs and looks after small business websites in Fairfax County and across Northern Virginia, then helps people find them. Prices are published below and fixed in writing before anything starts.

Free, no obligation

A free report on your current website

Send us your web address and we will run the same checks we run on our own site, then send you a plain English report within two business days. There is no charge, and no obligation to buy anything afterward.

Domain and email

Certificate validity, DNS setup, and whether your domain is configured to stop other people sending email that looks like it came from you.

Speed and mobile

How quickly pages load, how they behave on a phone, and anything that loses visitors before the page has finished arriving.

Search and readability

Whether search engines can read your pages properly, whether titles and descriptions are set, and whether the text is readable for everyone.

What it costs

Nothing. Every finding is marked pass, warning or fail, with what it means and whether it is worth fixing. Some clients fix the warnings themselves.

How it works

From first contact to a site that is live

01

Free report

Send your web address, or tell us there is no site yet. A plain English report comes back within two business days.

02

A conversation

We go through what the report found and what you actually want the site to do for the business. There is no charge for this.

03

Fixed quote

You receive the price in writing before any work starts. Work quoted above $300 takes a sixty percent deposit, then twenty percent at the midpoint and twenty percent on completion.

04

Build and hand over

We build it, you review it, and we walk you through how to use it. Then you decide whether you want a care plan.

Fixed price in writing before work begins

One point of contact throughout

A website is not only a design job. It is a domain, a certificate, email that has to keep working, and a server that someone has to look after. That side is where we started, and it is why the free report begins there.

Questions

Do I have to buy anything to get the free report?

No. The report is free and carries no obligation. If your site is already in good shape, we will tell you that and you will have lost nothing.

Do you build on WordPress?

We build on whichever platform suits the job and explain the trade-offs before you decide. What matters is that the site is fast, works on a phone, and does not lock you in.

Can I edit the site myself?

Yes, on the Business package and above. You can change text, photos and hours without calling anyone, and we walk you through it at handover.

What if I already have a website?

Then the free report is the right starting point. Sometimes the answer is a handful of fixes rather than a rebuild, and we would rather tell you that than sell you a new site.

How long does a build take?

A starter site is usually two to three weeks once we have your content. The honest delay on most projects is waiting on text and photos, so we help with that where we can.

Do you work outside Northern Virginia?

Website and marketing work is handled remotely, so location does not matter for this division. On-site computer and network work stays within Northern Virginia.
